claims: The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony takes place on April 17, 2026.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony takes place at Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony is headlining WrestleMania 42 weekend.
Headliners for the 27th class include Stephanie McMahon, AJ Styles, Demolition (Ax & Smash), and Dennis Rodman.
Sid and Bad News Brown are in the Legacy wing.
Stephanie McMahon is inducted by The Undertaker.
AJ Styles is a Grand Slam Champion.
Demolition (Ax and Smash) is a renowned 1980s tag team.
Demolition had a long tag title reign.
Dennis Rodman is known for his NBA career and WCW appearances.
Sid Vicious (Sid/Sycho Sid) is a two-time WWE/WCW Champion.
Bad News Brown is known for his intense style in the late 1980s.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony is on Friday, April 17, 2026, at 9 p.m. PT.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony airs live on the ESPN app in the U.S.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony airs live on YouTube internationally.
The Immortal Moment is Hulk Hogan vs. Andre the Giant at WrestleMania III.
